conventions.ports: template labels of RL/work/S3/s0_lib.py (equal to oph_defects.fedgeom)
conventions.cells: cell indices of s0_lib.build_mesh(level) (the pinned order; children of c are 4c..4c+3)
conventions.rule: T(c -> c') = h_c' r^k' g r^-k h_c^-1, g = identity or one of the 15 half turns; k, k' positions of the shared edge
conventions.S: g = identity: the three glue ports of c go to the three glue ports of c' in cyclic order, glued port to glued port
conventions.R0: the two glue ports of c that are not on this seam go crosswise to the two of c' that are not on it
conventions.R1: the glue port of this seam and the next one (cyclic order) go crosswise to the next one and the seam port of c'
conventions.R2: the glue port of this seam and the previous one go crosswise to the previous one and the seam port of c'
conventions.holonomy: product of the transports once counter-clockwise around a mesh vertex
